reviewMethod: Manual inspection at original raster resolution against the immutable synthetic HTML source, declared page geometry, required text, and clipping/placement expectations.
approvalScope: Compact PR A local correctness references. Exact raster equality is a provisional, nonblocking result label and is not a release gate.

requiredSteps: Generate a candidate from an immutable synthetic fixture in an ignored audit run directory.
Inspect the complete referenced page at original resolution against explicit source and geometry expectations.
Record the reviewer, reason, tool versions, fixture hash, image hash, and review notes in a deliberate pull-request change.
Run the harness self-tests and complete compact benchmark after the reference change.
